zh.heroKicker: 牌照申请进行中 · 美元结算
zh.heroBody: 美瑞德是美元计价的多资产交易所。贵金属、加密货币、大宗商品和外汇各有独立订单簿。黄金仍按毫克撮合，只是其中一本。居住地覆盖亚洲各辖区，并保留美国。贵金属、大宗商品和外汇默认开放；当地禁止居民交易加密货币的辖区默认关闭。行情为参考价。新加坡牌照申请进行中。杠杆、永续和跟单在取得牌照前保持模拟并默认关闭。没有真实资金。
zh.principlesTitle: 三件我们故意不做的事
zh.p1b: 买金付全款，卖金交全额。账上没有信用额度。
zh.p2b: 首发只记美元。新元或令吉由客户的银行换成美元后再入金。
zh.p3b: 新加坡运营公司与马来西亚占位实体各记各的账，跨实体成交走往来科目。
zh.s1b: 居住地、制裁标记和来源 IP。制裁命中直接拒绝。来源国与居住地不一致只告警。
zh.s2b: 买单冻结美元，卖单冻结黄金。余额不够就进不了订单簿。
zh.s3b: 价格优先，然后时间优先。自成交和价格带之外的单会被拒绝。
zh.s4b: 成交在同一笔记账里完成货银对付。撤单则解冻剩余部分。
zh.jurMyB: 未受全面制裁的亚洲居住地可以开户。贵金属、大宗商品和外汇默认开放。中国大陆、孟加拉国、尼泊尔、卡塔尔、科威特、阿曼、伊拉克和阿富汗的加密货币默认关闭。
zh.jurUsB: 允许开户与交易。美元是结算货币，不是准入黑名单。
zh.jurOtherB: 朝鲜、伊朗、叙利亚硬关闭，合规页不能改开。阿富汗和缅甸可以开户，但要做加强尽职调查。
zh.d1: 登录后完成核验即可交易。验证器密钥只在注册时显示一次。
zh.d2: 终端里看订单簿、深度、逐笔和价格路径。做市程序会一直报价，并偶尔吃掉一小口。
zh.d3: 下一笔限价单，或在资金页做一笔模拟入金、模拟入库。
zh.d4: 来源国和居住地不一致会留下告警，但不会因此停掉交易。只有合规官把某个国家设成「关闭」时，该来源才会被拦住。
zh.d5: 用合规官账户打开监察页：客户与 KYC、美国客户、制裁拒绝、辖区开关和变更记录、告警、账本是否平衡。
zh.mfaNote: 没有动态验证码就不能登录，也不能下单。
zh.gatedBody: 这个产品还不能用真实资金下单。想试用，打开右上角的模拟交易。虚拟资金不会进入主账本，也不会出现在真实余额里。

zh.liveReduce: 已关闭新开仓。现有仓位只能减仓或平仓，余额可以转回现货。
zh.liveMarginBody: 逐仓或全仓。用保证金钱包里的美元做多或做空，盈亏记在真实账本。
zh.livePerpBody: XAU、BTC、ETH 永续。标记价跟随现货盘口。资金费和强平记在真实账本。
zh.liveCopyBody: 只跟随已报名的真实账户。战绩来自他们自己的成交，没有虚构曲线。

zh.liveIsolatedNote: 逐仓只用这一笔仓位自己的保证金。

zh.liveSameWallet: 划出和划入不能是同一个钱包。

zh.liveTransferOut: 这个产品关闭时，只能把余额转回现货钱包。

zh.liveAllocNeed: 跟单金额要大于 0，并且不超过合约钱包 {wallet} 和产品上限 {cap}。
zh.liveLossNeed: 最大亏损要大于 0，并且不超过跟单金额。
zh.liveReduceCap: 只减仓数量大于持仓时，会按持仓数量成交。
zh.kycBody: 这里不连接真实的 Singpass 或制裁供应商。你填的居住地、国籍和制裁标记会直接交给辖区规则。

zh.indicativeNote: 每个合约有独立订单簿。公开行情作参考锚；全部源失败时按该品种波动率随机游走。不是持牌报价。

zh.onlyXau: 本场所只接受 XAU/USD 委托。其他金属只是参考报价。
zh.feeNewFills: 新费率只用于新成交。已有成交保持原样。
zh.liveBookNote: 本簿接受限价和市价。止损、IOC、FOK 和只挂单尚未接入。
zh.feeHelp: 挂单和吃单费率按你的 30 日成交额等级计算。限价未立刻成交按挂单费率估算，市价按吃单费率估算。

zh.riskBody: 美瑞德 M1 是沙盒。没有真实资金、真实银行、真实 KYC 或真实交割。价格来自做市。参考金属不是可成交报价。牌照申请完成之前，这里不能承接真实客户。

zh.convertBody: 按订单簿给出锁定报价，加一笔很小的点差，十秒有效。成交优先以 IOC 打到盘口；盘口不够时，由主体账户补上，并记入复式账本。

zh.marginBody: 全仓或逐仓，2 到 10 倍。借入和归还只发生在模拟账本。

en.sandbox: Sandbox · no real money · no real bank · no real KYC
en.heroKicker: Licence application in progress · USD settlement
en.heroBody: Meridex is a USD-quoted multi-asset venue. Precious metals, crypto, commodities and FX each have their own book. Gold still matches in milligrams, one book among them. Residence covers Asia and still includes the United States. Metals, commodities and FX are open by default; crypto is closed where local law prohibits it. Prices are indicative. The Singapore licence application is in progress. Leverage, perpetuals and copy trading stay closed everywhere until a licence. There is no real money.
en.principlesTitle: Three things this market will not do
en.p1b: Buys pay in full. Sells deliver in full. There is no credit line.
en.p2b: Launch currency is USD only. SGD or MYR is converted at the customer's own bank.
en.p3b: Singapore OpCo and the Malaysia placeholder keep separate books. Cross-entity trades use intercompany accounts.
en.s1b: Residence, a sanctions flag, and source IP. A sanctions hit is refused. A source country that does not match residence is only an alert.
en.s2b: A buy reserves dollars. A sell reserves gold. If the balance is short, the order never reaches the book.
en.s3b: Price first, then time. Self-trades and prices outside the band are rejected.
en.s4b: The fill is delivery-versus-payment inside one ledger posting. A cancel releases whatever is left.
en.jurMyB: Non-sanctioned Asian residences can onboard. Metals, commodities and FX are open by default. Crypto is closed for mainland China, Bangladesh, Nepal, Qatar, Kuwait, Oman, Iraq and Afghanistan.
en.jurUsB: Onboarding and trading allowed. USD is the settlement currency, not a block list.
en.jurOtherB: North Korea, Iran and Syria are hard-closed and cannot be reopened from compliance. Afghanistan and Myanmar can onboard, and they require enhanced due diligence.
en.d1: After sign-in, finish verification before trading. The authenticator secret is shown once, at registration.
en.d2: The terminal shows the book, depth, prints, and the session price path. Market-maker bots keep quoting and occasionally lift a small size.
en.d3: Place a small limit order, or mock a dollar deposit and a vault receipt on the funds page.
en.d4: A source country that differs from residence writes an alert and does not stop the order. Only a country set to “block” by compliance is refused.
en.d5: Sign in as compliance: customers and KYC, US customers, the sanctioned rejection, the jurisdiction switches and their audit trail, alerts, and whether the ledger still balances.
en.mfaNote: Without the authenticator code there is no session, and no way to trade.
en.gatedBody: This product cannot take orders with real funds. To try it, turn on simulation at the top. Virtual funds stay out of the main ledger and out of real balances.
en.liveNotice: Internal liquidity, no external market maker yet
en.liveReduce: New orders are closed. Open positions can only be reduced or closed, and spare balance can move back to spot.
en.liveMarginBody: Isolated or cross. Long or short with USD from the margin wallet. PnL posts to the real ledger.
en.livePerpBody: XAU, BTC, and ETH perpetuals. Mark follows the spot book. Funding and liquidation post to the real ledger.
en.liveCopyBody: Follow real accounts that opted in. Stats come from their own fills. There is no fabricated curve.
en.liveCloseAllAsk: Close every position in this product at the current mark?
en.liveRiskAck: I understand this leverage can be liquidated
en.liveNoLeaders: No trader has opted in yet.
en.liveNoStats: No closed trades yet, so there is no win rate to show.
en.liveWalletHint: Move USD from spot into the wallet before you trade. The transfer stays inside your real balances.
en.liveFundingNote: Funding settles every 8 hours. Longs pay 0.01% and shorts receive it. The internal book takes the imbalance.
en.liveInterestNote: Margin interest of 0.01% of borrowed notional is deducted from margin every 8 hours.
en.liveNeedPrice: A limit order needs a price.
en.liveNeedFunds: Free margin in this wallet is not enough.
en.liveBadStep: Quantity has to sit on the step size and meet the minimum.
en.liveApplies: Leverage and margin mode apply to new orders.
en.liveCrossNote: Cross margin counts free wallet balance in the liquidation buffer.
en.liveIsolatedNote: Isolated margin uses only this position's own margin.
en.liveBadQty: Quantity has to be a number above 0.
en.liveBadPrice: Price has to be a number above 0.
en.liveRiskNeed: Above 3×, or when liquidation is within 20% of the mark, confirm the liquidation risk first.
en.liveRiskNear: Estimated liquidation is about {pct}% from the mark.
en.liveSameWallet: The source and destination wallets are the same.
en.liveBadAmount: Amount has to be above 0, with at most 6 decimal places.
en.liveNeedWallet: The source wallet does not have enough free balance.
en.liveTransferOut: While this product is off, balance can only move back to the spot wallet.
en.livePartialOver: The close quantity cannot be larger than the position.
en.livePartialRest: The remainder would be below the minimum, so this closes the whole position.
en.liveBadMargin: Margin amount has to be above 0.
en.liveAddOff: You cannot add margin while this product is off.
en.liveStopAsk: Stopping closes the copied positions at the current mark. Continue?
en.liveNameLen: Display name needs 2 to 40 characters and cannot contain a line break.
en.liveAllocNeed: Allocation has to be above 0 and within the derivatives wallet {wallet} and the product cap {cap}.
en.liveLossNeed: Max loss has to be above 0 and no larger than the allocation.
en.liveReduceCap: A reduce-only quantity above the position fills only the position size.
en.kycBody: Nothing here calls Singpass or a sanctions vendor. Residence, nationality, and the sanctions flag go straight into the jurisdiction rules.
en.emptyBook: The book is empty. The market makers will quote once they are running.
en.countryHint: Simulated source country. A mismatch with residence is only an alert. A country is blocked only after compliance sets it to block.
en.noSession: Sign in first. Trading, funds, and KYC all require a password and an authenticator code.
en.secretOnce: Store this secret in an authenticator. Every sign-in asks for a fresh 6-digit code.
en.notionalHint: A buy reserves the quote asset at the limit. A sell reserves that asset for the quantity.
en.marketHint: A market order trades only inside the protection price. The rest is cancelled.
en.postHint: A post-only order is rejected in full if it would trade immediately.
en.fokHint: If it cannot fill entirely, the whole order is rejected.
en.iocHint: Fill what is there. Cancel the rest.
en.limitHint: Anything left rests on the book.
en.indicativeNote: Each symbol has its own book. Public feeds are a reference anchor; if every source fails, price follows a random walk at that asset's volatility. Not a licensed quote.
en.sessionStats: 24h change, high, low, and volume use a rolling 24-hour window.
en.onlyXau: This venue accepts XAU/USD only. The other metals are reference quotes.
en.feeNewFills: New rates apply to new fills. Existing fills stay as they were.
en.liveBookNote: This book accepts limit and market. Stop, IOC, FOK, and post-only are not on this book yet.
en.feeHelp: Maker and taker rates follow your 30-day volume tier. A resting limit is estimated at the maker rate. A market order is estimated at the taker rate.
en.announcements: Local · Singapore licence application in progress · no real money · no real bank
en.riskBody: Meridex M1 is a sandbox. There is no real money, bank, KYC vendor, or delivery. Prices come from the market maker. Reference metals are not executable. Until the licence application is granted, this is not a place for real customers.
en.trustCustodyB: The ledger records dollars and grams. There is no real vault.
en.trustSegB: Customer balances are booked apart from the operating company.
en.trustMasB: Singapore licence application in progress. This is not a licensed exchange.
en.termsBody: These are placeholder terms, not a client agreement and not legal advice. Residence covers Asian residences and still includes the United States. North Korea, Iran and Syria are hard-closed. Crypto stays closed where local law prohibits it. There is no real money and no licensed trading service. Binding terms wait on a licence and counsel.

en.voice3: Layout sample: paper funds and the main ledger are two sets of numbers.
en.convertBody: A firm quote from the book, plus a small spread. It lasts ten seconds. A fill is an IOC against the book, or a principal fill if the book cannot.
en.convertFirm: You will not fill worse than this rate.
en.recurringBody: A fixed USD amount into an allowed book, on a daily, weekly, or monthly clock. Each run is a normal IOC buy.
en.recurringClockHint: 1 is real time. 60 makes a day pass in 24 minutes. 1440 makes a day pass in one minute.
en.marginBody: Cross or isolated, 2× to 10×. Borrow and repay stay in the paper namespace.
en.marginWarn: Borrowing can liquidate the position. This is not open for real accounts.
en.marginHardUs: US residents cannot use margin or perpetuals, including in paper. That block is not a switch.
en.perpBody: XAU, BTC, and ETH perpetuals. Mark and index follow the spot book. Funding, PnL, and liquidation are simulated.
en.copyBody: Fictional strategy bots. Following them copies a paper trade only.
en.copyDisclaimer: Copying a strategy can be investment advice. This desk has no adviser licence. Leaders are labelled fiction.

ms.sandbox: Kotak pasir · tiada wang sebenar · tiada bank sebenar · tiada KYC sebenar
ms.heroKicker: Permohonan lesen sedang berjalan · penyelesaian USD
ms.heroBody: Meridex ialah tempat berbilang aset berdenominasi USD. Logam berharga, kripto, komoditi dan FX masing-masing ada buku sendiri. Emas masih dipadankan dalam miligram, satu buku antara yang lain. Kediaman meliputi Asia dan kekal termasuk Amerika Syarikat. Logam, komoditi dan FX dibuka secara lalai; kripto ditutup di tempat undang-undang tempatan melarangnya. Harga ialah rujukan. Permohonan lesen Singapura sedang berjalan. Leveraj, kontrak kekal dan salin dagangan ditutup di semua tempat sehingga ada lesen. Tiada wang sebenar.
ms.principlesTitle: Tiga perkara yang pasaran ini tidak lakukan
ms.p1b: Beli bayar penuh. Jual serah penuh. Tiada talian kredit.
ms.p2b: Mata wang pelancaran ialah USD sahaja. SGD atau MYR ditukar di bank pelanggan.
ms.p3b: Syarikat operasi Singapura dan entiti sandaran Malaysia menyimpan buku berasingan. Dagangan rentas entiti guna akaun antara syarikat.
ms.stepsTitle: Apa yang berlaku pada satu pesanan
ms.s1b: Kediaman, bendera sekatan, dan IP sumber. Padanan sekatan ditolak. Negara sumber yang tidak sepadan dengan kediaman hanya amaran.
ms.s2b: Beli menempah dolar. Jual menempah emas. Jika baki tidak cukup, pesanan tidak masuk buku.
ms.s3b: Harga dahulu, kemudian masa. Dagangan sendiri dan harga di luar jalur ditolak.
ms.s4b: Isian ialah serahan-lawan-bayaran dalam satu catatan lejar. Pembatalan melepaskan baki.
ms.jurMyB: Kediaman Asia yang tidak disekat secara menyeluruh boleh dibuka. Logam, komoditi dan FX dibuka secara lalai. Kripto ditutup untuk China daratan, Bangladesh, Nepal, Qatar, Kuwait, Oman, Iraq dan Afghanistan.
ms.jurUsB: Pembukaan akaun dan dagangan dibenarkan. USD ialah mata wang penyelesaian, bukan senarai sekatan.
ms.jurOtherB: Korea Utara, Iran dan Syria ditutup keras dan tidak boleh dibuka semula dari pematuhan. Afghanistan dan Myanmar boleh dibuka, dan memerlukan usaha wajar diperketat.
ms.d1: Selepas log masuk, selesaikan pengesahan sebelum berdagang. Rahsia pengesah dipaparkan sekali, semasa pendaftaran.
ms.d2: Terminal menunjukkan buku, kedalaman, cetakan, dan laluan harga. Pembuat pasaran terus sebut harga dan sekali-sekala angkat saiz kecil.
ms.d3: Letak pesanan had kecil, atau buat deposit dolar dan resit peti besi simulasi di halaman dana.
ms.d4: Negara sumber yang berbeza daripada kediaman menulis amaran dan tidak menghentikan pesanan. Hanya negara yang ditetapkan “tutup” oleh pematuhan ditolak.
ms.d5: Log masuk sebagai pematuhan: pelanggan dan KYC, pelanggan AS, penolakan sekatan, suis bidang kuasa dan jejak audit, amaran, dan sama ada lejar masih seimbang.
ms.mfaNote: Tanpa kod pengesah tiada sesi, dan tiada cara untuk berdagang.
ms.gatedBody: Produk ini belum boleh menerima pesanan dengan dana sebenar. Untuk mencuba, hidupkan simulasi di atas. Dana maya tidak masuk lejar utama dan tidak muncul dalam baki sebenar.
ms.liveNotice: Kecairan dalaman, belum ada pembuat pasaran luar
ms.liveReduce: Pesanan baharu ditutup. Posisi terbuka hanya boleh dikurangkan atau ditutup, dan baki bebas boleh dipindah ke spot.
ms.liveMarginBody: Terasing atau cross. Beli atau jual dengan USD dari dompet margin. PnL masuk lejar sebenar.
ms.livePerpBody: Perpetual XAU, BTC dan ETH. Harga markah ikut buku spot. Pendanaan dan likuidasi masuk lejar sebenar.
ms.liveCopyBody: Ikut akaun sebenar yang mendaftar. Statistik datang dari dagangan mereka sendiri. Tiada lengkung rekaan.
ms.liveCloseAllAsk: Tutup setiap posisi produk ini pada harga markah semasa?
ms.liveRiskAck: Saya faham leveraj ini boleh dilikuidasi
ms.liveNoStats: Belum ada dagangan ditutup, jadi tiada kadar menang.
ms.liveWalletHint: Pindahkan USD dari spot ke dompet sebelum berdagang. Pindahan kekal dalam baki sebenar anda.
ms.liveFundingNote: Pendanaan diselesaikan setiap 8 jam. Posisi beli bayar 0.01% dan posisi jual terima. Buku dalaman menanggung ketidakseimbangan.
ms.liveInterestNote: Faedah margin 0.01% daripada nilai dipinjam ditolak dari margin setiap 8 jam.
ms.liveNeedFunds: Margin bebas dalam dompet ini tidak cukup.
ms.liveBadStep: Kuantiti mesti pada langkah dan tidak kurang daripada minimum.
ms.liveApplies: Leveraj dan mod margin dipakai pada pesanan baharu.
ms.liveCrossNote: Cross mengira baki bebas dompet dalam penampan likuidasi.
ms.liveIsolatedNote: Terasing hanya guna margin posisi ini.
ms.liveRiskNeed: Melebihi 3×, atau bila likuidasi dalam 20% dari harga markah, sahkan risiko likuidasi dahulu.
ms.liveRiskNear: Anggaran likuidasi kira-kira {pct}% dari harga markah.
ms.liveSameWallet: Dompet sumber dan destinasi adalah sama.
ms.liveBadAmount: Jumlah mestilah lebih daripada 0, dengan paling banyak 6 tempat perpuluhan.
ms.liveNeedWallet: Dompet sumber tidak cukup baki bebas.
ms.liveTransferOut: Semasa produk ini tutup, baki hanya boleh dipindah balik ke dompet spot.
ms.livePartialOver: Kuantiti tutup tidak boleh lebih besar daripada posisi.
ms.livePartialRest: Baki akan di bawah minimum, jadi ini menutup seluruh posisi.
ms.liveAddOff: Anda tidak boleh menambah margin semasa produk ini tutup.
ms.liveStopAsk: Berhenti akan menutup posisi yang disalin pada harga markah semasa. Teruskan?
ms.liveNameLen: Nama paparan perlu 2 hingga 40 aksara dan tidak boleh mengandungi baris baharu.
ms.liveAllocNeed: Peruntukan mestilah lebih daripada 0 dan dalam dompet derivatif {wallet} serta had produk {cap}.
ms.liveLossNeed: Rugi maksimum mestilah lebih daripada 0 dan tidak melebihi peruntukan.
ms.liveReduceCap: Kuantiti kurang-sahaja yang melebihi posisi hanya diisi sebanyak posisi.
ms.kycBody: Tiada apa di sini memanggil Singpass atau vendor sekatan. Kediaman, kewarganegaraan, dan bendera sekatan masuk terus ke peraturan bidang kuasa.
ms.emptyBook: Buku kosong. Pembuat pasaran akan sebut harga apabila mereka berjalan.
ms.countryHint: Negara sumber simulasi. Ketidakpadanan dengan kediaman hanya amaran. Negara disekat hanya selepas pematuhan menetapkannya kepada tutup.
ms.noSession: Log masuk dahulu. Dagangan, dana, dan KYC memerlukan kata laluan dan kod pengesah.
ms.secretOnce: Simpan rahsia ini dalam pengesah. Setiap log masuk meminta kod 6 digit baharu.
ms.notionalHint: Beli menempah aset sebut harga pada had. Jual menempah aset itu mengikut kuantiti.
ms.marketHint: Pesanan pasaran hanya berdagang dalam harga perlindungan. Selebihnya dibatalkan.
ms.postHint: Pesanan siarkan sahaja ditolak sepenuhnya jika ia akan berdagang serta-merta.
ms.fokHint: Jika tidak boleh diisi sepenuhnya, seluruh pesanan ditolak.
ms.iocHint: Isi apa yang ada. Batalkan selebihnya.
ms.limitHint: Apa yang tinggal berada di buku.
ms.indicativeNote: Setiap simbol ada buku sendiri. Suapan awam ialah sauh rujukan; jika setiap sumber gagal, harga mengikut perjalanan rawak pada volatiliti aset itu. Bukan sebut harga berlesen.

ms.termsBody: Ini terma pemegang tempat, bukan perjanjian pelanggan dan bukan nasihat undang-undang. Kediaman meliputi Asia dan kekal termasuk Amerika Syarikat. Korea Utara, Iran dan Syria ditutup keras. Kripto kekal tertutup di tempat undang-undang tempatan melarangnya. Tiada wang sebenar dan tiada perkhidmatan dagangan berlesen. Terma mengikat menunggu lesen dan peguam.
